window_days_from_first_bill.quote: The application period for completion of a financial assistance application is available for a minimum of 240 days from the date Sabetha Community Hospital provides the patient with the first post discharge billing statement for patient services.

decision_days.quote: The Hospital’s Business Office will send a written notice of determination to the patient or guarantor within 30 days of receiving the completed application

eca_wait_days.quote: Sabetha Community Hospital will not take ECAs against an individual for at least 120 days from the date Sabetha Community Hospital provides the individual with the first post-discharge bill for care
